{{Quote|But, my Lord, the arena's restraints... They haven't been properly tested!|The Neimoidian aide, to Baron Tarko|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Neimoidian''' from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] was one of the [[Aide/Legends|aides]] to [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Tarko-se Arena]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tarko-se/Legends|Tarko-se]], which was located on the [[purse world]]. He had [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], green skin, no [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and wore a large head-dress and decorative clothing while at the arena.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Biography==
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="TFUIIComic">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref> the [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]],<ref name="TFUII" /> who had been captured after a failed [[Raid on Cato Neimoidia|raid]] on the planet,<ref name="TFUIINovel">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> was forced to fight a horde of rabid beasts and gladiators in the Tarko-se Arena for the pleasure of the local [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Merillion Tarko]]. After watching the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] defeat a [[Massiff/Legends|massiff]] and yet another [[Frank|executioner]], the disappointed Baron ordered the aide to give it another try by releasing the [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] [[Corellian slice hound|slice hounds]] into the arena.<ref name="TFUII" />

When [[Subject 1138|Starkiller]], a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Death/Legends|late]] [[Galen Marek]], entered the arena to relieve an exhausted General Kota, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] aide was ordered by the enraged Baron Tarko to open the gate of the massive creature known as the [[Gorog (creature)|Gorog]], ignoring his attendant's misgivings over their ability to control the beast. The Neimoidian reluctantly complied with Tarko's order.<ref name="TFUII" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Neimoidian aide first appeared in [[Sean Williams]]' novel [[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''The Force Unleashed II'']], published on [[October 10]], [[2010]]. He appeared a second time in the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'', released on [[October 26]] of the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. He was voiced by [[David W. Collins]].
